description: Clip-local rest-relative rotation attenuation for proportion/deformation hot spots. The shared converter and approved walk are not modified.

luigi_armature_luigirun.reason: The source run has large but correct excursions. Waluigi's longer limbs and overlapping branches visually amplify them; reduce limb angular amplitude while retaining timing and direction.

luigi_armature_luigijump.reason: Only slightly reduce the mapped body curl and Waluigi-right arm reach responsible for the frame-0 glove/leg crowding. Keep the source's airborne frame-24 ending; it is not a landing pose.

luigi_armature_swimbreast.reason: Reduce only the left forearm/elbow branch excursion that overextends or reverses visually on Waluigi's proportions. Apply one positive scale across all overlapping lower-arm branches to preserve bend direction and branch coherence.
